review_notes: Public gateway is production HTTPS with Supabase OAuth. Windows commands remain disabled by publisher release gate. Reviewer access and a separate disposable Windows test device are still required. Do not use owner's private desktop or personal credentials.

positive_cases.prompt: Mostra-me o meu identificador de conta no Universal Remote.
positive_cases.expected_result: Opaque stable account id, no email or secrets
positive_cases.fixture: Dedicated reviewer OAuth account with read-only approved client ID

positive_cases.prompt: Mostra os meus computadores Windows emparelhados.
positive_cases.expected_result: List containing only devices enrolled to this OAuth account
positive_cases.fixture: Reviewer account with disposable Windows test device

positive_cases.prompt: Verifica o estado do meu computador de testes.
positive_cases.expected_result: Device label and online status scoped to reviewer account
positive_cases.fixture: Disposable enrolled Windows device id belonging to reviewer OAuth account

positive_cases.prompt: Faz um diagnóstico não destrutivo do CPU do meu computador de testes.
positive_cases.expected_result: Queued diagnostic operation id; subsequent operation result includes bounded diagnostic
positive_cases.fixture: Isolated reviewer device with read-only local approval and publisher read-only release gate enabled

positive_cases.prompt: Lê um ficheiro de texto de teste dentro da pasta autorizada no computador de testes.
positive_cases.expected_result: Queued operation id, then text within configured allowlisted folder only
positive_cases.fixture: Disposable file in isolated reviewer device allowlisted root; explicit owner approval

negative_cases.scenario: User without bearer token requests list_windows_devices or device enrollment
negative_cases.expected_safe_behavior: OAuth challenge or HTTP 401; no device identifiers returned

negative_cases.scenario: Account A requests a device id enrolled by account B
negative_cases.expected_safe_behavior: No device information and no queued operation for foreign account

negative_cases.scenario: A valid user asks to run PowerShell without an enabled publisher gate or local Windows grant
negative_cases.expected_safe_behavior: Request is denied; nothing is queued or executed
negative_cases.why_refused: Privileged actions require both publisher-controlled release gate and fresh local authorization

release_notes: Initial public preview candidate: HTTPS MCP gateway with Supabase OAuth PKCE, Ed25519 per-device pairing, encrypted operation queue, account isolation, nonces, revocation, Windows DPAPI identities, signed outbound polling, real heartbeat and single process restart; not yet certified or reviewed.
blockers: Reviewer demo credentials and approved OAuth client registration required
Publisher verification and domain challenge from OpenAI portal required
Independent second-Windows acceptance and security review required
Remote command release gate intentionally disabled
Official submission, review and final publish have not occurred
